ruling.set: licences/licence_table.md, Stage 1 row of sft-code-opencodereasoning-2: allowed (TSAI admitted, 11 Nov 2026). prepare_ocr2.py and pack_admission.py read the table themselves and refuse a policy that says anything else.
ruling.teacher: TSAI data rule of 3 Nov: output of open-weight models under MIT or Apache-2.0 is in; DeepSeek-R1 is named.
open: training pack for the OCR-2 SFT subset: the set is allowed (TSAI admitted, 11 Nov 2026), but no pack can be built until the sources below are approved and identity-verified, Team 3 approves a tokenizer and a context limit is set
per source: the producer's original revision and row order (see source manifest, identity)
Team 9 confirmation for the Codeforces pool before open-r1/codeforces rows are used
the target-quality thresholds below are a proposal for the lead and TSAI, not a ruling

teacher.note: qwq_critique (QwQ-32B) is a separate signal about the solution. It is never the SFT target.

target_quality.note: A critique of 'wrong' or a pass_rate under min_pass_rate leaves the row out. pass_rate -1 means no execution evidence: kept, tagged exec_missing, never counted as a pass.
